children: Germany’s Ifo Business Climate Index rose to 89.9 in September 2026, up from 88.8 in August and comfortably above the market expectation of 89.0.

The reading marked its highest level since May 2023 and the fifth consecutive monthly increase, suggesting that business sentiment in Europe’s largest economy is continuing to improve despite an energy price shock that has pushed fuel costs to record highs.
Both components of the index strengthened during the month.
The expectations index climbed to 90.4 from 89.0, pointing to greater optimism about economic prospects in the months ahead.
Meanwhile, the current conditions index rose to 89.5 from 88.5, indicating a modest improvement in firms’ assessment of the current business environment.

title: German Business Climate Hits Highest Level in Over Three Years
